ayahs.2: because the blind man came to him.
ayahs.3: You never know—perhaps he would be purified,
ayahs.4: or take heed and benefit from the reminder.
ayahs.5: As for the one who felt self-sufficient,
ayahs.6: you gave him your full attention,
ayahs.7: though you are not to blame if he refuses to be purified.
ayahs.8: But the one who came running, eager,
ayahs.9: in awe of Allah and eager to learn,
ayahs.12: so let whoever wills be mindful of it.
ayahs.13: It is recorded on honoured pages,
ayahs.15: in the hands of noble scribes,
ayahs.17: May those who reject the truth be ruined—how ungrateful they are!
ayahs.18: From what did He create them?
ayahs.19: From a drop of fluid He created them and proportioned them,
ayahs.20: then made the path of life easy for them,
ayahs.21: then causes them to die and be buried,
ayahs.22: then when He wills, He will resurrect them.
ayahs.23: No—they have not fulfilled what He commanded.
ayahs.25: how We pour down rain in abundance,
ayahs.32: all as sustenance for you and your animals.
ayahs.33: Then when the Deafening Blast comes—
ayahs.34: that Day a person will flee from their brother,
ayahs.37: Each will have enough concern of their own.
ayahs.38: Some faces that Day will be radiant,
ayahs.40: while other faces will be dust-covered,
ayahs.42: those are the wicked who rejected the truth and lived in sin.
